user.title: Share your heating
user.description:
You'll need a thermostat and an outdoor temperature sensor. Your home appears on the map as part of the 5 km square centred on {area}. Your exact location never leaves Home Assistant.

If your thermostat doesn't report whether the boiler is actually firing, pick a sensor or switch that does.

data_description.indoor_temperature_entity: Leave empty to use the thermostat's own reading.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: A sensor outside your home, or a weather integration's temperature. Its reading is shown as your area's outside temperature.
data_description.heating_active_entity: Leave empty to use the thermostat's heating status.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the website. Check the address and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This home is already sharing its heating.
abort.no_location: Set your home location in Settings, System, General first.
